report_name: VISION 100M Preference Optimization (DPO) Audit & Readiness Report
methodology: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) via implicit reward formulation
mathematical_objective: L_DPO(pi_theta; pi_ref) = -E_{(x, y_w, y_l)} [ log sigma( beta * log(pi_theta(y_w|x)/pi_ref(y_w|x)) - beta * log(pi_theta(y_l|x)/pi_ref(y_l|x)) ) ]

preference_criteria_evaluated.standard: Zero conversational fluff when concise output requested
Strict negative constraints (e.g. do not use word 'plant')
Exact domain definitions (e.g. PID terms) vs fabricated pseudocode
Executable SQL/Python vs syntax error SQL
Refusal to hallucinate future events (e.g. 2046 World Cup)
Rejection of logical fallacies (affirming the consequent)

governance_rule: DPO will ONLY be applied after SFT achieves verified loss convergence and non-zero benchmark probe accuracy. Preference optimization must never be introduced purely to appear advanced without verified empirical gains.
